action_items: RESOLVED-by-testing-agent: CSV downloads for new report types (/api/admin/reports/{workers|gigs|activity|earnings}.csv) were returning 404 because the JSON generic route `/admin/reports/{report_type}` was declared BEFORE the CSV route `/admin/reports/{report_type}.csv` in server.py. FastAPI evaluates routes in declaration order and the {report_type} param greedily matched 'workers.csv'. Fixed by reordering — CSV route now declared first. Please review the swap in /app/backend/server.py around lines 2929-3008 to confirm acceptable.
Consider widening the default date range on the AdminReports page so Gigs/Activity/Earnings/Timesheets tabs show data on first load (currently shows 0 rows because default range = today only).
critical_code_review_comments: Route declaration order matters in FastAPI: more-specific routes (with a literal suffix like `.csv`) must be declared BEFORE the catch-all `{report_type}` route. This was the original source of the CSV bug.
AdminReports.jsx is 771 lines — getting close to the recommended 700-line threshold. Consider extracting the per-report-type filter cells into a separate FilterPanel component for maintainability.
experience_level='' truthy guard fix at server.py line ~593 is correct and verified by 3 new pytest cases (empty accepted, valid value accepted, invalid 'guru' still rejected).

rca of the issue: CSV-download 404 RCA: FastAPI evaluates path-operations in declaration order. The route `/admin/reports/{report_type}` (JSON) was declared on line ~2931 and the more-specific `/admin/reports/{report_type}.csv` on line ~2969. Because `{report_type}` uses the default `[^/]+` regex which matches dots, requests to `/admin/reports/workers.csv` were captured by the JSON route with report_type='workers.csv' → not in REPORT_TYPES → HTTP 404 'Unknown report_type: workers.csv'. Mitigation: declare the CSV route BEFORE the JSON route so FastAPI picks the more specific template first. Verified: all 4 CSV endpoints (workers/gigs/activity/earnings) now return 200 text/csv with proper Content-Disposition. Regression: /admin/reports/timesheets and /admin/reports/timesheets.csv still served by their explicit dedicated endpoints — unchanged.
